scenario.title: Phone triage, mixed questioning technique
scenario.patient_background: Called in about occasional chest tightness after exertion.

transcript.content: You haven't had any chest pain or shortness of breath, have you?
And you're managing okay at home, taking all your tablets, eating fine?
Can you tell me more about what 'not really' chest pain means?
Sometimes a slight tightness after stairs.

audio.note: This benchmark contains no real audio recordings for any case.
